Eli: Heads-up: two inbound customer asks (FastForms + HealthEdge) for an 'Optimize Advisor' that recommends batching/caching/quant profiles and raises eval-triggered alerts. Need to scope for the next sprint.

Eli: Proposed split: v0 = read-only recommender + alerting hooks; v1 = ops-facing apply flow behind canary. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

Priya: Proposal for v0 acceptance gates: 
- recommendation signal quality: eyeballed sample (3/5 prompts) shows cost or latency uplift with no quality regressions
- eval alerts: concordance < 0.92 OR BLEU down >5% triggers alert
- perf safety: when suggestions are enabled (not auto-apply) p95 latency for short-chat (<=128 tokens) stays <200ms on hosted tier

Jonah: +1 to read-only start. Implementation notes: quant recommendations need two tiers: 
- safe: post-training int8 (broad compat)
- aggressive: int4 / QAT (requires per-model validation)
We should include a risk_score and projected memory/latency delta with each rec.

Marta: Customer notes: FastForms is throughput-first and open to aggressive pilots. HealthEdge is conservative (audit + KMS). Recommend pilot FastForms, delay HealthEdge auto-changes until audit checklist done.

Priya: For eval-triggered alerts, proposed signals: concordance on seeded promptset (customer-editable), tokens-per-infer trend, and latency anomalies (p99 > 2x baseline). Alert flow: Slack channel + email + ops ticket. Example rule: 
```
when concordance < 0.92 for 3 consecutive 1h windows -> create alert: eval-fallout
```

Jonah: Batching recs depend on request histograms. Suggest advisor output a small DSL: 
```
batch_hint: max_batch_tokens=8192; preferred_batch_size=8; pad_strategy=dynamic
```
Also include fallback profile in case quantized kernels produce artifacts.

Eli: Can console let customers edit eval sets? HealthEdge will add PII-sensitive prompts and require audit trail.

Priya: Yesconsole will allow per-customer eval-sets and an audit flag. Marked-sensitive sets require manual approval for any auto-apply later. For v0 they only power alerts.

Marta: Prioritization (quick score by impact/cost/risk): 
- read-only advisor + alerts: impact high / cost ~3-4w / risk low -> Priority A
- auto-apply adjustments: impact high / cost 6-8w / risk medium -> Priority B
- aggressive int4 autosuggests: impact medium / cost high / risk high -> Priority C

Jonah: Note: KV-cache + quant kernels can cause subtle drift for long contexts >1024; add warning when seq_len>1024.

Eli: Locked scope for next sprint: ship v0 (read-only advisor with batching/caching/quant recs + eval alerts), pilot with FastForms only, HealthEdge onboarding plan in parallel. Acceptance = Priya's criteria + a pilot dashboard with ~10 validated recs.

Priya: Owners: Priya (PM), Jonah (eng lead), Marta (customer liaison). Delivery checklist: 1) advisor schema + DSL doc, 2) console eval-sets + audit flags, 3) alert rules + notification templates, 4) FastForms pilot playbook.

Jonah: I'll write an RFC for the advisor schema and example outputs (safe/aggressive) including expected memory/latency deltas. ETA: RFC by EOW, dev spike next sprint.

DevBot: runbook autogenerated -> /runbooks/optimize-advisor-v0. :white_check_mark: 

Marta: I'll schedule FastForms kickoff and draft HealthEdge audit checklist.

Eli: If no objections by EOD I'll lock the sprint card and add acceptance criteria. :+1:
